clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Jonathan Carevin hunts the dangers gathering in Duskwood. He and his family take the fight beyond the Night Watch's patrols, pursuing undead, worgen, demons, and heretics beneath the forest canopy.

The Night Watch guards Darkshire and patrols its roads, but Jonathan Carevin believes defense alone cannot protect the township. He hunts the unholy creatures roaming Duskwood with his family and allies such as Calor. His crusade, fought in the name of the Light, targets demons, undead, and heretics across the region.
